name: JFCS Food Pantry
description: Jewish Family and Children's Services (JFCS) runs food banks offering nutritious, high-protein food to seniors on fixed incomes, adults with disabilities, low-income young families, and others facing a temporary crisis.
fullDescription: Jewish Family and Children's Services (JFCS) runs food banks offering nutritious, high-protein food to seniors on fixed incomes, adults with disabilities, low-income young families, and others facing a temporary crisis.
whatTheyOffer:
- Nutritious, high-protein food
- For seniors on fixed incomes and adults with disabilities
- For low-income young families and people facing a temporary crisis
- Food banks at JFCS offices in San Francisco, Marin, San Mateo, and Palo Alto
- Volunteer grocery delivery to some clients' homes
howToGetIt: Call JFCS at 415-449-3700 to ask about eligibility and how to get food from your nearest JFCS Food Bank.
areaLabel: San Francisco, Marin, San Mateo & Palo Alto
keywords: JFCS, Jewish Family and Children's Services, food bank, food pantry, senior food, disabled, San Francisco, Marin, San Mateo, Palo Alto, high protein
